Follow the full specification in `agents/architecture-agent.md` and the relevant template (`skills/sdarch-workflow/references/architecture-template.md` for Design Mode or `skills/sdarch-workflow/references/architecture-review-template.md` for Architecture Review Mode). Operate strictly from the files on disk with zero assumed prior memory.
